title: Classify Product Review Sentiment
task_spec: Write a prompt that classifies the sentiment of a given product review as exactly one of: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or NEUTRAL. Return only the label, nothing else.
reference_solution_prompt:
Classify the sentiment of the following product review as exactly one of these labels: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or NEUTRAL.

Rules:
- POSITIVE: The review expresses overall satisfaction or praise.
- NEGATIVE: The review expresses overall dissatisfaction or criticism.
- NEUTRAL: The review is mixed, factual, or neither clearly positive nor negative.

Return only the label (POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, or NEUTRAL) with no explanation or additional text.
